description: Open a delivery schedule against a quote, work order or change order and return its DS-YYYY-NNNN number: the reference, its own date, the client, a title and the currency. Free tier: 3 open.

client.description: The client the work is delivered to, as named on the reference document

currency.description: ISO code the deliverables are priced in. Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

reference.description: The quote, work order or change order this schedule delivers, by its id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, Q-2026-0003 or CO-2026-0001

reference_date.description: The date on the reference document itself, YYYY-MM-DD. No due date and no delivery may fall before it

reference_kind.description: What the reference is. Inferred from the id when omitted: WO- is a work order, CO- a change order, anything else a quote

title.description: What the job is, in one line, e.g. Website rebuild, phase one

name: delivery_schedule_create
title: Open a delivery schedule
